text:
noah: heads up - after today's RBAC prune, we started seeing intermittent mTLS failures in us-east-1 around 11:04 UTC
sophia: noticing TLS alert 46 in proxy logs, downstreams report `KMS:AccessDenied` on decrypt attempt
diego: which RBAC prune? I removed `kms:Decrypt` from `proxy-service-role` during cleanup window at 11:00 to tighten lateral key access
sophia: that matches the window. some services rely on that role to unwrap ephemeral keys for client certs
noah: rolling back now, but we need a safer plan. Rolling to previous role at 11:07 UTC
platform-oncall: rollback complete, traffic recovered in ~60s. impact: ~25 failed handshakes, no customer-visible errors beyond retrying upstreams
security-bot: audit: sampling for mtls_events set to low (1%), and sensitive fields redacted (`tls_principal`, `enc_key_id`). This makes triage harder
diego: redaction was added to prevent key identifiers leaking to observability, but we didn't keep a separate retained trail for security incident investigations
sophia: propose: keep redacted live stream, but send full unredacted mtls_event payloads to secure-audit-bucket with 90d retention and strict ACLs. Add KMS envelope to protect stored payloads
noah: agree. also need RBAC change playbook: (1) preflight: enumerate services using role via `kubectl auth can-i` and `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` (2) canary: apply role change to single region dev proxy, run handshake canary (3) monitor mtls sampling override and cloudtrail for key denies
diego: action items: create terraform-managed `mtls-canary-role` with minimal kms:Decrypt scoped by condition `kms:ViaService` and `aws:SourceRegion` for canaries
platform-oncall: I'll add a temporary sampling override: `POST /audit/override {match: "event:mtls_event AND region:us-east-1", rate: 0.2, ttl: 6h}`
security-bot: note created: INC-2026-0489. Recommended evidence: proxy logs (raw), cloudtrail KMS events, IAM policy diff, helm patch diff, k8s events, archived unredacted mtls_event payloads in secure-audit-bucket
sophia: follow-up owners: @noah to draft RBAC playbook, @diego to author mtls-canary terraform, @platform-oncall to implement sampling override and S3 lifecycle change
diego: I'll also add a CI gate: any PR removing `kms:Decrypt` from `proxy-service-role` must include a `mtls-impact` sign-off checklist and a canary run id
noah: thanks. scheduling 30m postmortem sync 13:00 UTC today to review checklist and retention changes :thumbsup:
